plugin.name: Vault Mind
ribbon.hint: Vault Mind: open the command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+P) to run actions.
modal.title: Optimize note (AI)
settings.provider.name: Link type
settings.provider.desc: Choose the AI backend used for all features.
settings.test.name: Test connection
settings.test.desc: Send a tiny ping to verify the current provider settings.
settings.test.noModel: Add at least one model in "Model names" before testing the connection.
settings.openaiKey.name: API key
settings.openaiKey.desc: Stored locally in plugin data. Sent only to the Base URL you configure.
settings.openaiBaseUrl.name: Base URL
settings.openaiModel.name: Model name
settings.openaiModel.desc: e.g. gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4o, or any compatible model id.
settings.ollamaBaseUrl.name: Ollama Base URL
settings.ollamaModel.name: Ollama Model
settings.modelLinks.add.name: Add model link
settings.modelLinks.add.desc: Add a new AI backend link. You can configure multiple models under one link.
settings.modelLinks.search.name: Search model links
settings.modelLinks.search.desc: Filter the list below by link name in real time.
settings.modelLinks.empty: No model links yet. Click the button above to add one.
settings.modelLinks.table.name: Name
settings.modelLinks.modal.name: Link name
settings.modelLinks.modal.nameDesc: Used to identify this link. Must be unique.
settings.modelLinks.modal.modelsDesc: Configure multiple models: type and press Enter or comma to add; click × on a tag to remove it.
settings.modelLinks.modal.modelPlacehold: Type a model id and press Enter to add…
settings.modelLinks.modal.nameRequired: Vault Mind: link name cannot be empty.
settings.modelLinks.modal.nameDuplicate: Vault Mind: a link with this name already exists. Pick another name.
settings.modelLinks.modal.maxTokensDesc: Max output tokens per AI request. Enter 0 for unlimited.
settings.modelLinks.modal.temperatureDes: Value 0–2; lower = more deterministic, higher = more creative.
settings.modelLinks.modal.secretPicker.n: No valid value for this secret
settings.realtime.name: Realtime autoprompt
settings.realtime.desc: Show inline ghost-text suggestions while typing (accept with Tab).
settings.debounce.name: Realtime debounce (ms)
settings.debounce.desc: Idle time after typing before a suggestion is requested.
settings.optimizeCurrent.name: Optimize current note
settings.optimizeCurrent.desc: Enable the "Optimize current note" command in the command palette to polish the active Markdown note with AI.
settings.linkFormat.name: Internal link format
settings.linkFormat.desc: Which internal link syntax AI should use when optimizing notes.
settings.linkType.name: Internal link type
settings.linkType.desc: Which path style AI should use when referencing internal notes.
settings.chatPanel.name: Open AI chat panel
settings.chatPanel.desc: Enable the "Open AI chat panel" command in the command palette.
settings.addCurrentNoteToChat.name: Attach current note to chat
settings.addCurrentNoteToChat.desc: When opening the AI chat panel, automatically attach the active Markdown note as context.
settings.showReasoning.name: Show AI reasoning
settings.showReasoning.desc: Display the model's reasoning (thinking) process above its reply. Only applies when the model returns reasoning_content (e.g. DeepSeek-R1, OpenAI o1 and other reasoning models).
settings.frontmatterGeneration.name: Auto-generate frontmatter
settings.frontmatterGeneration.desc: Enable the "Generate frontmatter" command in the command palette. Reads the current Markdown note and asks AI to produce YAML frontmatter.
settings.frontmatterTemplate.name: Frontmatter template
settings.frontmatterTemplate.desc: Custom system prompt used when generating frontmatter. Leave empty to use the default template.
settings.frontmatterTemplate.placeholder: e.g. Generate title, date, tags, and summary based on the note content...
settings.fetchWebContent.name: Fetch web content
settings.fetchWebContent.desc: Enable the "Fetch web content" command in the command palette. Enter a URL to convert the page body to Markdown and insert it into the current note.
settings.fetchWebContent.saveImages.name: Save images locally
settings.fetchWebContent.saveImages.desc: Download images on the page into a local attachments folder and reference local images in the note.
settings.fetchWebContent.linkType.name: Image link type
settings.fetchWebContent.linkType.desc: Which path form to use when referencing saved images.
settings.fetchWebContent.linkFormat.name: Image link format
settings.fetchWebContent.linkFormat.desc: Use Wikilink or Markdown link syntax for saved image references.
modal.fetchWebContent.title: Fetch web content
settings.maxTokens.name: Max tokens
settings.maxTokens.desc: Upper bound for AI output length per request.
settings.temperature.name: Temperature
settings.temperature.desc: Range 0–2; lower is more deterministic, higher is more creative.
error.noApiKey: OpenAI API key is not set. Open Settings → Vault Mind and enter your key.
error.noModelLink: Vault Mind: no model link is configured. Open Settings → Model configuration to add one.
error.streamingNotSupported: Streaming is not supported in this environment; falling back to normal request.
view.tokensHint: Token usage for this reply (prompt + completion)
frontmatter.systemPrompt: You are a metadata assistant. Based on the Markdown note provided by the user, generate a concise and relevant YAML frontmatter. Include standard fields such as title, date, tags, category, summary, and keywords. Return only a YAML block wrapped in `---`, with no explanation or additional content.
view.title: AI Chat
view.welcome: Ask me anything about your vault or the active note.
view.placeholder: Type a message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)
view.confirmDelete: Delete session "{title}"? This cannot be undone.
view.timeout: Request timed out (no response within 60s). Please check if the model configuration is correct and the network is reachable.
view.openFailed: Could not open AI chat panel.
settings.section.provider.desc: Select the AI backend, connection credentials, model parameters, and data folder.
settings.section.autoprompt.desc: Configure AI inline suggestions, note optimization, chat panel, frontmatter generation, and web content fetching behavior.
settings.section.memoryChat.desc: Controls AI role settings, knowledge base context injection, and long-term profile memory.
settings.memoryProfileEnabled.name: Enable user profile memory
settings.memoryProfileEnabled.desc: When enabled, the AI extracts key facts from chat history into memory/MEMORY.md and injects it as background context for each chat. When disabled, extraction and injection stop.
settings.roles.title: Role info
settings.roles.add.name: Add role
settings.roles.add.desc: Add an AI role (name + prompt). Set it as default to inject it into the system prompt of every AI feature.
settings.roles.search.name: Search roles
settings.roles.search.desc: Filter the list below by role name in real time.
settings.roles.empty: No roles yet. Click the button above to add one.
settings.roles.table.name: Name
settings.roles.modal.name: Role name
settings.roles.modal.nameDesc: Used to identify this role. Must be unique.
settings.roles.modal.namePlaceholder: e.g. Legal advisor, Translator, Code reviewer
settings.roles.modal.promptDesc: Describe the role's stance, tone, and responsibilities. Injected into the system prompt of every AI feature (chat, optimize, autoprompt).
settings.roles.modal.promptPlaceholder: e.g. You are a seasoned legal advisor. Explain clauses in plain language and flag potential risks.
settings.roles.modal.nameRequired: Vault Mind: role name cannot be empty.
settings.roles.modal.nameDuplicate: Vault Mind: a role with this name already exists. Pick another name.
settings.memoryProfileCategories.name: Profile dimensions
settings.memoryProfileCategories.desc: One dimension per line. The AI extracts key information from all chat history into memory/MEMORY.md using these dimensions.
settings.memoryProfileCategories.placeho:
Occupation
Tech stack
Output preferences
Project background
Habits
Key facts
Todos
settings.memoryFile.name: Memory file (MEMORY.md)
settings.memoryFile.desc: View and edit the AI-curated long-term profile memory. Changes are auto-saved to memory/MEMORY.md in the AI folder 0.5 seconds after you stop typing.
settings.memoryFile.placeholder: Memory content will load here. If nothing appears yet, background organization may still be running.
settings.includeVaultIndex.name: Knowledge base index
settings.includeVaultIndex.desc: Add a list of all Markdown file paths to the system prompt so the AI knows what's in your vault. Contents are NOT loaded unless attached or referenced.
settings.chatContextMaxChars.name: Max chars per attached file
settings.chatContextMaxChars.desc: Truncate each attached file's content to this many characters before sending to the AI.
settings.section.skills.desc: Manage AI skills enabled by default for new chats.
settings.skillsEnabled.name: Enable skills
settings.skillsEnabled.desc: Show the "Skill" button in the chat panel and allow skill content injection. When off, the button is hidden and the list below becomes view-only.
settings.defaultSkills.desc: Skills are .md files under the AI folder's skills/ directory (instructions, templates, or reference material). Toggle which skills are enabled by default for new chats. Only enabled skills' content is sent to the AI; inactive ones appear as a name-only index.
settings.defaultSkills.empty: No skills found. Add .md files under the AI folder's skills/ directory (README.md is ignored).
settings.defaultSkills.refresh.name: Skill refresh
settings.defaultSkills.refresh.tooltip: Rescan the skills/ directory and refresh the list
settings.defaultSkills.search.name: Skill search
settings.defaultSkills.search.desc: Filter the skill list below by name or path in real time.
settings.defaultSkills.table.name: Name
settings.aiFolderName.name: Data storage path
settings.aiFolderName.desc: Name of the data folder (at the vault root) that stores memory and skills. Changing it does not auto-migrate old data.
settings.section.web.desc: Configure web search backends available in chat.
settings.webSearchEnabled.name: Enable web search
settings.webSearchEnabled.desc: Master switch for web search. Even when on, it only runs when you explicitly toggle the 🌐 button in a chat.
settings.webSearchProvider.name: Search provider
settings.webSearchProvider.desc: Which search backend to use. Tavily / Serper (Google) / Brave / SearXNG.
settings.webKeys.tavily.name: Tavily API keys
settings.webKeys.tavily.desc: One key per line (or comma-separated). Keys are polled in order; if one fails or is rate-limited, the next is tried.
settings.webKeys.serper.name: Serper API keys
settings.webKeys.serper.desc: One key per line (or comma-separated). Keys are polled in order.
settings.webKeys.brave.name: Brave Search API keys
settings.webKeys.brave.desc: One key per line (or comma-separated). Keys are polled in order.
settings.webKeys.searxng.name: SearXNG instances
settings.webKeys.searxng.desc: One instance base URL per line (e.g. https://searx.example.com). Instances are tried in order.
settings.webSearchMaxResults.name: Max results
settings.webSearchMaxResults.desc: Maximum number of search results fetched per query.
settings.webSearchMaxChars.name: Max chars per result
settings.webSearchMaxChars.desc: Truncate each result's snippet to this many characters before sending to the AI.
settings.webSearchShowCitations.name: Show source citations
settings.webSearchShowCitations.desc: Ask the AI to cite web sources inline using [n] markers matching the numbered results.
view.noNewAttachment: Vault Mind: no new files/folders added.
view.picker.title: Attach from vault
view.picker.desc: Select files or folders to attach as context. Only the content of attached files is sent to the AI; everything else is paths-only.
view.noNewSkill: Vault Mind: no new skills added.
view.skillPicker.title: Manage skills for this chat
view.skillPicker.desc: Enable skills to load their content into the AI context. Inactive skills are only listed by name so the AI knows they exist and can suggest enabling them.
view.webToggle: Toggle web search for this chat (only searches when enabled)
view.webNoResults: Vault Mind: web search returned no results.
view.webNoCredentials: Vault Mind: web search is on but no API keys/instances are configured. Add them in settings.
view.modelPicker.title: Select Model
view.modelPicker.desc: Choose the AI model for this conversation. Models are grouped by link.
view.modelPicker.empty: No model links configured. Please add one in Settings.
view.rolePicker.title: Select Role
view.rolePicker.desc: Choose the default role. Its prompt will be injected into the system prompt for all AI features.
view.rolePicker.empty: No roles added yet. Please add one in Settings.
view.reasoning.title: Reasoning
